title: Icon Costume 솔로 #017 · hourglass bombshell · 스팀펑크 · lambskin nappa · 손 허리 · 가을 공원 · 로리타 갸루
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a deep ebony-brown complexion, late 20s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, shaggy layered ash brown hair — wearing a skin-tight micro steampunk set, a cropped sleeveless bustier top of ultra-thin matte espresso-brown lambskin nappa with small brass gears riveted along both sides of the front zipper, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to the cropped hem and the two sides of the lambskin nappa fully covering her bust, ending right under her bust with her whole midriff and stomach bare, and a micro skirt of the same lambskin nappa with two brass-buckled straps across the hem and a brass pocket-watch chain draped from her left hip bone, sitting at the top of her hip bones with a plain ultra-high slit up the right side from the hem to her hip bone, the hem ending just below her hip bones, her arms and legs bare, the lambskin nappa shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands and very fine pale hair on her forearms catching the light. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin lambskin nappa molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the brass gears, the brass buckles and the pocket-watch chain glinting against the matte nappa, fine stretch lines and a soft sheen. Pose: full frontal wide stance, both fists pressing outer hips outward to absolute maximum — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of glossy espresso brown leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each longer than her middle finger, in espresso brown lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: heavy gold rings on every finger, thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, and a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: large round eyes with bright real catchlights, thick curled lashes with drawn-on lower lashes, soft pink and lilac eyeshadow, round pink blush, glossy cherry-pink lips.

Background: a sunlit autumn park with orange trees, a stone bridge with a waist-high parapet and a standard bench on a leaf-strewn path, just after the rain, with wet surfaces shining softly, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
